sources.fact: LBBD73/CI Thames Road is 2.6ha, 1,844-3,344 net dwellings, mixed ownership and pending-decision.
Brownfield notes identify component applications including 22/02211/FULL and 21/01232/FULL; these are not whole-site consents.
CI geometry is blank and only a point is supplied; the point is not the transformation-area/red-line/title polygon.
21/01232/FULL at 7 Thames Road proposed 131 homes plus industrial space; committee delegated grant subject to Mayor/S106/conditions.
22/02211/FULL at 13-15A Thames Road proposed 245 homes plus 2,714 sqm industrial floorspace; committee delegated grant subject to Mayor/S106/conditions.
March 2022 Planning Committee agenda confirms 7 Thames Road application identity and conditional decision route.
July 2023 Planning Committee agenda confirms 13-15A Thames Road exact application and 245-unit proposal.
Regulation 19 materials separately identify CI Thames Road as a wider allocation, distinct from individual application red lines.
The adopted Local Plan provides current allocation policy context; it does not merge component planning permissions.
Current development-plan policy remains separate from exact case decision evidence.
All Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; register capacity is not permission itself.
Planning Data API geometry/coverage rules do not permit replacing missing site geometry with point buffers or nearest cases.

examples.result: CI remains pending-decision at wider-site level.
21/01232/FULL contributes 131 proposed homes, not the full CI capacity.
22/02211/FULL contributes 245 proposed homes, not the full CI capacity.
131 + 245 = 376 component units; 376 is not substituted for the 1,844-3,344 wider-site capacity range.
Committee delegated grant subject to S106/Mayor is not silently converted to issued permission without final-case evidence.
Mixed ownership is not converted into title ownership.
Blank CI geometry is not repaired using component site plans or point buffers.
Promotion remains zero until exact whole-site/title relation and current statutory overlays are executed.
